lines: Now the whole worship is set forth, by the glorious Kaula way,
for the fit, firm-mounted on resolve awake as this. The Yogasaṃcāra declares: bliss is Brahman — throned in the body, lips and lowest end, three-established.
sanskrit_cite: atha samastā iyam upāsā samunmiṣattādṛśadṛḍhavāsanārūḍhān adhikāriṇaḥ prati śrīmatkaulikaprakriyayā nirūpyate tatra uktaṃ yogasaṃcārādau ānandaṃ brahma taddehe tridhauṣṭyāntyavyavasthitam

lines: Who lets it go, straying from Brahman-abiding,
is cut off from bliss.
sanskrit_cite: abrahmacāriṇas tasya tyāgād ānandavarjitāḥ

lines: And those who stall-feed the wheel on blissless, contrived fare —
sanskrit_cite: ānandakṛtrimāhāravarjaṃ cakrasya yājakāḥ

lines: both sink to dreadful hell. Hold, then, to this stance.
sanskrit_cite: dvaye 'pi narake ghore tasmād enāṃ sthitiṃ bhajet

lines: In this stance stands the Kula rite, sixfold:
without, in Śakti, in your own frame, in the pair, in breath, in knowing.
sanskrit_cite: tad anayā sthityā kulayāgaḥ sa ca ṣoḍhā bāhye śaktau svadehe yāmale prāṇe saṃvidi ca iti

lines: Each later rite outshines the one before;
each earlier ripens taste for what comes.
sanskrit_cite: tatra ca uttara uttara utkṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvas tadrucyartham

lines: Who seeks powers keeps second, fourth, and fifth entire;
for whom release is chief, the sixth leads — yet on feast-days he keeps the rest as he may, to crown the rite.
sanskrit_cite: siddhikāmasya dvitīyaturyapañcamāḥ sarvathā nirvartyāḥ ṣaṣṭhas tu mumukṣoḥ mukhyaḥ tasyāpi dvitīyādyā naimittike yathāsambhavam anuṣṭheyā eva vidhipūraṇārthaṃ ca

lines: The outer: a bliss-brimmed altar, the hero's bowl,
a crimson cloth — or liṅga and the rest, as taught before.
sanskrit_cite: tatra bāhyaṃ sthaṇḍilam ānandapūrṇaṃ vīrapātram aruṇaḥ paṭaḥ pūrvoktam api vā liṅgādi

lines: No bathing, no preliminaries — purity won by resting in full bliss alone.

Know breath, awareness, body first as one; then sound the mantra twenty-sevenfold — crown, brow, heart, secret, frame, forth and back — since awareness wears Paramaśiva's shape: the world-course fulfilled in the Supreme — below, between, above.
sanskrit_cite: tatra snānādikartavyānapekṣayaiva pūrṇānandaviśrāntyaiva labdhaśuddhiḥ prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃviddehaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā saṃvidaś ca paramaśivarūpatvāt saptaviṃśativāraṃ mantram uccārya mūrdhavaktrahṛdguhyamūrtiṣu anulomavilomābhyāṃ viśvādhvaparipūrṇatā parameśvare aparatve parāparatve paratve 'pi ca

lines: Thus: from Māyā, person, nature, mind to earth — twenty-seven principles, kalā within —
and in the knowing power, midway, the fivefold Brahman's moods — instant, born, become — twenty-seven in form. So sing the glorious Lakulīśas.
sanskrit_cite: tathāhi māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni kalādīnāṃ tatraiva antarbhāvāt vidyāśaktāv api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya sadyastvājātatvabhavodbhavatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam eva uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ

lines: In the highest too the Lord stands five-powered — five shapes to every power, twenty-five —
one power, undivided still. By a twenty-seven-formed pervasion
bind the flame of awareness-fire — judgment-shaped and breath-shaped — with one sounding alone,
so Paramaśiva alone stands bound, hastening nowhere past the tantra.
Mind thus ruled, make gifts, dwelling, quarters, ground of that same make;
fill the cup by crest-binding pervasion alone, and adore —
with its droplets adore the altars; thumb to ring-finger joined,
adore and sate the mantra-wheel on the body's wheels with its sap.
Then to the breath's far edge; then raise the trident-seat of triple powers ended —
to Māyā's edge, in lettered auṃ, raise the triple-powers-ended seat —
to Māyā's edge, in lettered auṃ — and there the deliberation-shaped to adore.
Thus, with one sounding, ground and grounded placed —
behold the world right there, in awareness turned grounded,
awareness-made as well. So the world through awareness, and her embrace:
from awareness arisen, settling there — world from the knowable risen, awareness resting there.
This much, no more: the awareness-principle, by the twofold embrace won.
sanskrit_cite: paratve 'pi pañcaśaktiḥ hi parameśvaraḥ pratiśakti ca pañcarūpatā evaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ śaktayaḥ tāś ca anyonyam anudbhinnavibhāgā ity ekā śaktiḥ sā cānudbhinnavibhāgā ity evaṃ saptaviṃśatirūpayā vyāptyā saṃvidagneḥ śikhāṃ buddhiprāṇarūpāṃ sakṛduccāramātreṇaiva baddhāṃ kuryāt yena paramaśiva eva pratibaddhā tantrātiriktaṃ na kiṃcid abhidhāvati tathāvidhabuddhyadhiṣṭhitakaraṇacakrānuvedhena purovartino yāgadravyagṛhadigādhārādīn api tanmayībhūtān kuryāt tato 'rghapātram api śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūrayet pūjayec ca tadvipruḍbhiḥ sthaṇḍilāny api tadrasena vāmānāmāṅguṣṭhayogāt dehacakreṣu mantracakraṃ pūjayet tarpayet ca tataḥ prāṇāntaḥ tataḥ sthaṇḍile triśūlātmakaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ kalpayet māyāntaṃ hi sārṇe aukāre ca śaktitrayāntaṃ tadupari yājyā vimarśarūpā śaktiḥ ity evaṃ sakṛd uccāreṇaiva ādhārādheyanyāsaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva ādheyabhūtāyām api saṃvidi viśvaṃ paśyet tad api ca saṃvinmayam ity evaṃ viśvasya saṃvidā tena ca tasyāḥ saṃpuṭībhāvo bhavati saṃvida uditaṃ tatraiva paryavasitaṃ yato viśvaṃ vedyāc ca saṃvit udeti tatraiva ca viśrāmyati iti etāvattvaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ saṃpuṭībhāvadvayāt labhyate

lines: So sung of old: the outflow gathered into the fold.
sanskrit_cite: tad uktam sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya iti

lines: Bring smoke and wine and blossoms to self-surrender's feet;
murmur in your own stillness, gather home, and give to the waters.
sanskrit_cite: tato gandhadhūpāsavakusumādīn ātmaprahvībhāvāntān arpayitvā svaviśrāntyā japtvā upasaṃhṛtya jale nikṣipet

lines: So ends the outer rite.
sanskrit_cite: iti bāhyayāgaḥ

lines: Now the Śakti. Gods and heroes of her ring, each two-kind,
awake — from play's first breath to outflow's end — Śiva with Śakti,
by mutual doing, by the high Lord's decree, in stainless shape: here pride of place.
By this the chosen wheel is Śakti-natured shown.
Serve here by crest-bound pervasion alone, on the triple-ended seat;
in the triangle's heart, outflow's power — yet the pervasion holds the difference.
sanskrit_cite: atha śaktau tatra anyonyaṃ śaktitālāsāvīrāṇām ubhayeṣām ubhayātmakatvena prollāsaprārambhasṛṣṭyantaśivaśaktiprabodhe parasparaṃ vyāpārāt parameśaniyatyā ca śuddharūpatayā tatra prādhānyam etena ca viśiṣṭacakrasyāpi śaktitvaṃ vyākhyātam tatra śikhābandhavyāptyaiva pūjanaṃ śaktitrayāntam āsanaṃ koṇatraye madhye visargaśaktiḥ iti tu vyāptau viśeṣaḥ

lines: So in your own frame: in that wheel itself;
then the lesser wheels the crown lets down.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ svadehe tatraiva cakre tato brahmarandhrādyanucakreṣu

lines: Now the pair. Hear the Śakti's sign: even so — no-two.
Set age and birth and all aside, hold nothing dear:
they are one who are born of the world-defying wed.
sanskrit_cite: atha yāmale śakter lakṣaṇam etat tadvad abhedas tato 'napekṣya vayaḥ jātyādīṃś cāsaṅgāt loketarayugalajaṃ hi tādātmyam

lines: Co-risen with cause and fruit, three-shaped — plain, or set in form —
the two adore each other, face to face,
and by their sating draw bliss near.
sanskrit_cite: kāryahetusahotthatvāt traidhaṃ sākṣād athānyathā kḷptāvato mitho 'bhyarcya tarpyānandāntikatvataḥ

lines: Praise the wheel as befits, and the lesser wheel behind —
without with blossoms to the inmost; within with scent and savor, wine and more.
sanskrit_cite: cakram arcet tadaucityād anucakraṃ tathānugam bahiḥ puṣpādināntaś ca gandhabhuktyāsavādibhiḥ

lines: Such the station surging with that bliss-heap's play.
And the lesser wheels melt in the wheel's own self.
sanskrit_cite: evam ānandasaṃdohitatacceṣṭocchalatsthitiḥ anucakragaṇaś cakratādātmyād abhilīyate

lines: Tasting own-being as each delight unfolds,
the lesser-wheel goddesses in order enter
the middle wheel — awareness' wheel.
sanskrit_cite: nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsamayasvarūpaparimarśe kramaśo 'nucakradevyaḥ saṃviccakraṃ hi madhyamaṃ yānti

lines: Power won by brimming the ray-host robed as lesser goddesses —
of that power's own kind, even so — turns face to face.
sanskrit_cite: anucakradevatātmakamarīcigaṇapūraṇādhigatavīryam tacchaktitadvadātmakam anyonyasamunmukhaṃ bhavati

lines: The tremor of throbbing entry to that pair's high home
shakes the lesser wheels as well — then That-made, no more apart.
sanskrit_cite: tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaspandajātasaṃkṣobham kṣubhnāty anucakrāṇy api tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthak tu

lines: Such this pair, its part-talk melted away: when so it is,
by rank and excellence, she herself is knowing clashing into outflow.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ yāmalam etad galitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadaiva tadā kramatāratamyayogāt saiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṃghaṭṭaḥ

lines: That steadfast, unsurpassed realm — the world both-kind and vast —
bliss, neither settled nor uprisen: womb and womb-cause of settled and risen, Kaula supreme.
sanskrit_cite: taddhruvadhāmānuttaram ubhayātmakajagad udāram ānandam no śāntaṃ nāpy uditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam

lines: Longing for the unparted station, make her — knowing — your own;
then the two-kind pair, settled and risen, dawn as one for bearer and borne.
sanskrit_cite: anavacchinnapadepsus tāṃ saṃvidam ātmasātkuryāt śāntoditātmakadvayam atha yugapad udeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ

lines: From self in other, other in self — where calm meets else,
of the two, by two-naturedness — she, power, risen even so, feeds the outflow on;
its bearer does not.
sanskrit_cite: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān

lines: In her the noble clan; through her, among men, the taught yoga-clashes.
Then — in the twofold outflow, in this settled-risen home — whoever ponders —
sanskrit_cite: tasyāṃ cāryaṃ kulam atha tayā nṛṣu proktayogasaṃghaṭṭān atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye 'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye 'nusaṃdadhate

lines: In the eastward seat, firm in the unparted station, outflow-robed —
the risen too is passed from mouth to mouth, from the chief mouth outward.
sanskrit_cite: prācyāṃ visargasattām anavacchidite pade rūḍhāḥ uditaṃ ca mitho vaktrān mukhyād vaktre pragṛhyate ca bahiḥ

lines: The goddess-wheel grows full, granting powers, wisdom, release.
Keep stillness, and reach still Śiva — here the goddess-wheel.
sanskrit_cite: tṛptaṃ devīcakraṃ siddhijñānāpavargadaṃ bhavati śāntābhyāse śāntaṃ śivam eti yad atra devatācakram

lines: The void, unblest — from bliss's own home the gift —
and the humming thrilled, tasting outward moods brimmed with own sap.
sanskrit_cite: śūnyaṃ nirānandamayaṃ nirvṛtinijadhāmato 'rghaṃ ca raṇaraṇakarasān nijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇarasena

lines: The inner-brimmed lesser wheel, surging, attains the wheel; it too surges as of old.
So this outflow's hidden sense is three.
sanskrit_cite: āntarapūrṇasamucchaladanucakraṃ yāti cakram atha tad api ucchalati prāgvad iti trividho 'nvartho visargo 'yam

lines: In this outflow's home, by savoring — in these three ways alone —
mantra-might bears each fruit in every knowing-womb.
sanskrit_cite: etad visargadhāmani parimarśanatas tridhaiva manuvīryam tattatsaṃvidgarbhe mantras tattatphalaṃ sūte

lines: On the lotus roofed with ever-dawning grace that nests in the triangle's heart —
the stalk unsundered, rooted in the true sixteen-petalled lotus.
sanskrit_cite: koṇatrayāntarāśritanityoditamaṅgalacchade kamale nityāviyutaṃ nālaṃ ṣoḍaśadalakamalasanmūlam

lines: In the flame at the churning of twin lotuses on the central stem —
from the central crash of moon-loveliness and the sun's gushing hosts.
sanskrit_cite: madhyasthanālagumphitasarojayugaghaṭṭanakramādagnau madhyasthaśaśadharasundaradinakarakaraughasaṃghaṭṭāt

lines: Wed to the three-petalled ruddy shoot of might — within, the sprouting forth.
Thus, by moon-and-sun-wondrous-meeting's seal — in a flash.
sanskrit_cite: tridalāruṇavīryakalāsaṅgān madhye 'ṅkurasṛṣṭiḥ iti śaśadharavāsarapaticitraguṣaṃghaṭṭamudrayā jhaṭiti

lines: Working the outflow-first order within, win firm ground in the fourth —
in the sky-farer's seal-entry, each to each, of own power and its lord.
sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādikramam antaḥ kurvaṃs turye sthitiṃ labhate etat khecaramudrāveśe 'nyonyaṃ svaśaktiśaktimatoḥ

lines: Who would dwell savor-made midst drink and delight, play and laughter —
through unvoiced voice, roar, outburst, hearkening, humming, hum's end.
sanskrit_cite: pānopabhogalīlāhāsādiṣu yo bhaved vimarśamayaḥ avyaktadhvanirāvasphoṭaśrutinādanādāntaiḥ

lines: That mantra-might, in truths unbroken and unstruck —
in outward-homeward pauses, in ear, in eye, where twin marks meet.
sanskrit_cite: avyucchinnānāhataparamārthair mantravīryaṃ tat gamanāgamaviśrāntiṣu karṇe nayane dvilakṣyasamparke

lines: In the sealing-yoga called the body's far end —
in the pair too, in the wheel — what, throat-faring from the heart 'twixt the breasts to the lip's verge, stays unvoiced.
sanskrit_cite: tatsammīlanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre kucamadhyahṛdayadeśād oṣṭhānte kaṇṭhagaṃ yad avyaktam

lines: Hearing what dwells between the twin wheels — when tremor ends, they settle there.
So this, eightfold and uttermost: Roar-Bhairava.
sanskrit_cite: tac cakradvayamadhyagam ākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo 'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ

lines: Since she is light and resonance, that mantra-clad pervasion stands highest:
in every deed the knower's — living, freedom.
sanskrit_cite: jyotir dhvaniś ca yasmāt sā māntrī vyāptir ucyate paramā karmaṇi karmaṇi viduṣaḥ syāj jīvato muktiḥ

lines: Knowing That, freed amid scriptures — a stranger-clan wisdom's vessel is the womb.
Make the home where void and non-void meet, fire and wind in the single staff.
sanskrit_cite: tajjñaḥ śāstre muktaḥ parakulavijñānabhājanaṃ garbhaḥ śūnyāśūnyālayaṃ kuryād ekadaṇḍe 'nalānilau

lines: The trident made one-savored — sap in sap abiding, as it were —
doubt cast off, rite renounced: I am not — thus brood.
sanskrit_cite: śūlaṃ samarasīkṛtya rase rasam iva sthitam tyaktāśaṅko nirācāro nāham asmīti bhāvayan

lines: See the body-housed goddesses — thrill and trembling in mind's wealth —
the goddess-host throned in ear, eye, mouth, and nose.
sanskrit_cite: dehasthā devatāḥ paśyan hlādodvegādi ciddhane karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam

lines: Ever beholding the grasper — by the Sky-Farer, sure success.
sanskrit_cite: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā sidhyati dhruvam

lines: In a far-off chasm hurl your frame in a flash — dwell gently, no force —
gather both hands, gaze outward: serve this sky-faring seal.
sanskrit_cite: śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svadehaṃ saṃpātayan vāsam asāhasena ākuñcya hastadvitayaṃ prapaśyan mudrām imāṃ vyomacarīṃ bhajeta

lines: So this is the pairing rite.
sanskrit_cite: ity eṣa yāmalayāgaḥ

lines: In breath — stated, pervaded, world-made — strengthened by gifts of cup and food, scent and smoke, through the taught knowing-pervasion: this is breath-rite.
sanskrit_cite: uktavyāptike prāṇe viśvamaye proktasaṃvidvyāptyā tarpaṇānnagandhadhūpādisamarpaṇena upodbalanaṃ prāṇayāgaḥ

lines: But rest struck deep and rooted is knowing-rite — taught long before.
sanskrit_cite: viśrāntirūḍhis tu saṃvidyāgaḥ prāg eva nirūpitaḥ

lines: Having honored any one of these rites — should the learner's heart be dyed doubtless —
then, the rite first beheld, with no ghee-and-grain before, give the glance that kindles, in pondering's order, by the pervasion of old.
Yet when the moon of occasion wanes, for unseen kindling and the rest, the elder rule alone stands.
sanskrit_cite: evam etebhyo yāgebhyo 'nyatamaṃ kṛtvā yadi tathāvidhanirvicikitsatāpacitritahṛdayaḥ śiṣyo bhavati tadā tasmai tadyāgadarśanapūrvakaṃ tilājyāhutipūrvakanirapekṣam eva pūrvoktavyāptyā anusaṃdhānakrameṇa avalokanayā dīkṣāṃ kuryāt parokṣadīkṣādike naimittikānte tu pūrva eva vidhiḥ

lines: By the rite's first rank alone is all this so.
sanskrit_cite: kevalam etad yāgapradhānatayā iti

lines: In the master's frame burns the seventh clan-rite, crown of all —
done once of old beside the rites, it fills the whole. Śivam.
sanskrit_cite: guruśarīre saptamaḥ kulayāgaḥ sarvottamaḥ so 'pi prāg yāgasāhityena sakṛd eva kṛtaḥ sarvaṃ pūrayati iti śivam
